=== DOCS-TRUTH (WebFetch 2026-06-08) ===
• docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-configs/trino-configs:
  - dbt-trino incremental_strategy values: `append` (DEFAULT), `merge`, `delete+insert`. NO `upsert`. NO `insert_overwrite` (dbt-spark-only).
  - `merge` REQUIRES `unique_key` (if your unique_key isn't actually unique, use `delete+insert` instead).
  - Supported materializations: `table`, `view`, `incremental`, `materialized_view`. (NOTE: `ephemeral` is a dbt-core universal materialization that works on every adapter including dbt-trino — not listed on the trino-configs page because it's adapter-agnostic.)
• trino.io/docs/467/sql/explain.html:
  - Plain `EXPLAIN` does NOT execute the query — it only shows the execution plan.
  - TYPE options: `LOGICAL` (single-fragment, deprecated), `DISTRIBUTED` (default), `VALIDATE` (returns boolean `Valid` column, no execution), `IO` (input/output details in JSON).
  - FORMAT options: `TEXT` (default), `GRAPHVIZ`, `JSON`.
  - Default is `TYPE DISTRIBUTED`.
• trino.io/docs/467/sql/explain-analyze.html: `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` ALWAYS executes the query (only option is VERBOSE).
• trino.io/docs/current/optimizer/cost-based-optimizations.html + trino.io/docs/current/admin/properties-general.html: `join_distribution_type` accepts `AUTOMATIC` (default) / `BROADCAST` / `PARTITIONED`. `join_max_broadcast_table_size` default `100MB`. SET SESSION = session-scoped until RESET SESSION or new session.
• trino.io/docs/467/sql/set-session.html: `SET SESSION <name> = <value>`; for connector-specific properties use `<catalog>.<property>` form.
